title: The price of the North Pitcher changed
why: The product page and product card display the price. The card appears on the home and category pages.
sql: UPDATE products SET price = 2600 WHERE id = 'p1'

title: The note on the Morning Pitcher changed
why: No code reads the note column, so nothing is recomputed.
sql: UPDATE products SET note = 'verified' WHERE id = 'p2'

title: The large North Pitcher is back in stock
why: The variant component on the product page reads the stock level. Its template switches branches, from Out of stock to 4 in stock.
sql: UPDATE variants SET stock = 4 WHERE sku = 'p1-l'

title: The Pitchers category was renamed
why: The header, a block shared by every page, and the category page both read the category name.
sql: UPDATE categories SET title = 'Pitchers and cups' WHERE id = 'c1'

title: A new product was added
why: The new row matches queries for products in the route's page list, the home page, the category page, and the header count.
